decision.reason: RETN's 28 September 2026 first-party announcement confirms a sixth physically diverse subsea Taiwan route for interruption resilience and capacity. Enterprise route-diversity review workflow is evidenced.

opportunities.core_job: Audit whether international connectivity alternatives share cable/landing point single-failure risks

opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual circuit-provider-route/cable/landing ID, shared risk group, contract SLA, failover drill evidence and reviewer signoff; no live topology APIs
